{{Top|leg}}
'''Maboo''' was a gummy kind of plant that grew in cane-like thickets. It was native to [[Shedu Maad]] and was one of the first plants to recover in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] abandoned [[Mining/Legends|mines]].
